program_name: Online Bachelor of Arts in Community Advocacy and Social Policy

programme_facts.value: This program prepares you to work within the social services sector across a variety of settings, including child welfare and human service agencies, mental health clinics, schools, hospitals and more. Additionally, this program provides a path to pursue graduate education.
